prompt:
Theme: Stone Path and White Summer

Subject:
A vertical portrait from the head to below the knees of a woman in her 20s wearing a white bikini and sheer robe on a traditional Japanese temple path under green shade. The woman occupies most of the space slightly to the left of the center. She stands facing forward, tilting her head slightly to her right and smiling gently at the camera. She lightly pinches the side ties of her bikini with her fingers.

Character and Expression:
Small oval face, light ivory skin, brown eyes with delicate lashes, and glossy coral pink lips. A friendly expression looking at the lens. Dark brown hair tied in a high loose ponytail with long strands flowing over her right shoulder. Soft dappled sunlight hits her head and shoulders. Wearing small metal earrings and a single-bead pendant.

Pose and Clothing:
A plain white triangle bikini with gathered edges and side-tie bottoms. Over it, she wears a very thin cream-colored sheer shirt or robe draped off the shoulders with wide sleeves and soft wrinkles. She holds the bikini ties naturally, creating gentle tension in the fabric.

Background and Light:
On the left is an old dark brown wooden building with glass doors and a white banner featuring a navy chrysanthemum crest. A gray stone path extends from the right into the background with stone lanterns and pillars. The top of the frame is covered in vibrant green leaves casting fine dappled light. Bright natural light comes from the upper right, illuminating her face, body, and the white fabric.

Composition and Camera:
Vertical 3:4 frame, shot from chest height with a slight downward angle. The figure occupies 90% of the screen height. Focus is sharpest on the eyes and face, while the background elements are softly blurred.

Texture and Style:
High-resolution realistic summer fashion photography. Colors include white, cream, warm skin tones, weathered wood, and stone gray. Precise rendering of skin texture, fabric gathers, and the coarseness of stone. Balanced contrast without blowing out highlights.

Negatives:
Avoid facial distortion, extra fingers, limb merging, unbalanced stance, clothing glitches, overexposure, and watermarks.
